caption: The preview before export: the note, 4 comments, the author and the new file name.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['note-word-comments']; P.pro.signOut(); window.__nwc?.close(); P.settings.author = 'Dana Reyes'; await P.saveSettings(); const f = app.workspace.getActiveFile(); window.__nwc = P.previewActive(f, app.workspace.activeEditor.editor.getValue()); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !['ready', 'blocked'].includes(document.querySelector('.nwc-modal')?.dataset.state); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); return document.querySelector('.nwc-modal')?.dataset.state; })()

caption: After export: a notice gives the new DOCX file and the comment count. The note is unchanged.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['note-word-comments']; P.pro.signOut(); P.lastExport = null; window.__nwc?.close(); P.settings.author = 'Dana Reyes'; await P.saveSettings(); const f = app.workspace.getActiveFile(); window.__nwc = P.previewActive(f, app.workspace.activeEditor.editor.getValue()); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !['ready', 'blocked'].includes(document.querySelector('.nwc-modal')?.dataset.state); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); document.querySelector('.nwc-modal .nwc-export').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && P.lastExport === null; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); return P.lastExport; })()
after: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['note-word-comments']; const f = P.lastExport && app.vault.getFileByPath(P.lastExport); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); P.lastExport = null; return 'ok'; })()

caption: Settings: the author name, authors from labels (Pro) and the GitHub Sponsors sign in.
eval: (async () => { window.__nwc?.close(); app.plugins.plugins['note-word-comments'].pro.signOut(); app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('note-word-comments'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: labels such as "Lee:" set the author of each comment.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['note-word-comments']; P.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('note-word-comments-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await P.pro.refreshNow(); window.__nwc?.close(); P.settings.author = 'Dana Reyes'; await P.saveSettings(); const f = app.workspace.getActiveFile(); window.__nwc = P.previewActive(f, app.workspace.activeEditor.editor.getValue()); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !['ready', 'blocked'].includes(document.querySelector('.nwc-modal')?.dataset.state); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); return document.querySelector('.nwc-modal')?.dataset.state; })()
